title: Public surfaces stop pointing at the source: the npm README carries MCP usage and the app serves its own docs

story.as_a: person outside the fleet who finds loopctl on loopctl.com or npm
story.i_want_to: install and configure the MCP server, read the API reference and reach the operator without access to the source repository
story.so_that: making the repo private breaks no link and hides nothing a user needs

rationale: PRD R12: the repo becomes private, the MCP package stays public with its own README, and /docs, /swaggerui and /api/v1/openapi stay served by the app. Today the app's own pages send readers into the repo. home.html.heex links github.com/mkreyman/loopctl at :86, :154, :205, :913 and :934, and docs/agent-delivery-loop.md at :800. docs.html.heex does the same at :65, :127, :1352 and :706. terms and privacy send contact by GitHub issue (:115, :137). /.well-known/loopctl advertises the repo as the MCP server's repository_url (well_known_controller.ex:34). mcp-server/package.json:23-27 names the repo too. After the flip every one of these answers 404 to anyone without access.

acceptance_criteria.description: mcp-server/README.md carries the MCP setup now only in the root README (README.md:786-914): the npx form of the .mcp.json block, the rule that keys go in the env block, and the tool summary as a pointer to its own tool tables. The root README's MCP section is replaced by one link to the npm package page.

mcp-server/package.json has no repository field, and mcp-server/README.md's Links section (:754-759) has no github.com link. `npm pack --dry-run` in mcp-server lists README.md, so the package page shows the usage.

GET /docs/delivery-loop (browser pipeline, unauthenticated) answers 200 with docs/agent-delivery-loop.md rendered to HTML by MDEx with the sanitize options WikiShowLive uses (wiki_show_live.ex:142-152). The markdown is read at compile time as an @external_resource. The Dockerfile builder stage copies that one file before compile, as it copies mcp-server/package.json for the same reason (Dockerfile:46), because it copies no docs/ directory today (Dockerfile:43-45).

No template under lib/loopctl_web links github.com/mkreyman/loopctl. The repo links in home.html.heex and docs.html.heex point to https://www.npmjs.com/package/loopctl-mcp-server, and no link whose href is that URL keeps the text 'GitHub': the top navs (home.html.heex:86-91, docs.html.heex:65-70), the mobile navs (home:154-159, docs:127-132) and the footers (home:934-939, docs:1352-1357) read 'npm', and the two 'View on GitHub' CTAs (home:205-210, :913-918) read 'View on npm'. docs/design-system.md changes with them: section 5 'Navigation (Landing Page)' draws the nav link as 'npm' to the package URL, and section 7 'Hero Section' draws the secondary CTA as 'View on npm' to the package URL, its rule reading 'Two CTAs: primary (sign up) and secondary (the npm package)'. The two agent-delivery-loop.md links point to /docs/delivery-loop.

The terms and privacy Contact sections give the operator address that /.well-known/loopctl advertises as contact (well_known_controller.ex:62) instead of GitHub issues. Both read it from one function, LoopctlWeb.Contact.email/0, so the pages and the discovery document cannot disagree.

/.well-known/loopctl's mcp_server.repository_url is replaced by mcp_server.package_url = https://www.npmjs.com/package/loopctl-mcp-server, and the discovery JSON schema served at /.well-known/loopctl/schema.json names the new field.
GET /docs, GET /swaggerui, GET /api/v1/openapi and GET /api/v1/ answer 200 with no authorization header, and no response body names github.com/mkreyman/loopctl.

test_cases.name: package README carries setup and the package names no repository (node --test)
steps: assert README.md contains "npx", "loopctl-mcp-server" and the env-block rule
assert package.json has no repository key
expected_results: README.md contains "npx", "loopctl-mcp-server" and the rule that keys go in the env block

test_cases.name: /docs/delivery-loop renders the reference (ConnCase)
expected_results: 200; the body contains the first H1 heading of docs/agent-delivery-loop.md inside the element carrying the prose class set, the docs page's nav, and no <script> tag

test_cases.name: no template links the repository (unit)
steps: in home.html.heex and docs.html.heex, read the text of every anchor whose href is the npm package URL
expected_results: no match; a failure names the file and line
no such anchor's text contains 'GitHub'; a failure names the file and line
neither section contains 'View on GitHub', 'secondary (GitHub)' or a github.com href

test_cases.name: terms and privacy show the discovery contact (ConnCase)
expected_results: both pages contain mailto:<contact>, where contact is the discovery document's contact value

test_cases.name: discovery advertises the package, not the repo (ConnCase)
expected_results: mcp_server.package_url is the npm URL; repository_url is absent from both

test_cases.name: public docs routes stay unauthenticated (ConnCase)
expected_results: each route answers 200 with no authorization header

technical_notes: Routes: /docs at lib/loopctl_web/router.ex:69 (browser scope :64-72, PageController.docs/2 at page_controller.ex:27); /api/v1/openapi at :162 and /api/v1/ at :163 (scope :159-164, pipe_through [:api] only); /swaggerui at :231-233; /swagger redirect at :236-238. Add `get "/docs/delivery-loop", PageController, :delivery_loop` beside :69.

Links to replace, with their labels (AC-52.65.4): home.html.heex:86, :154, :205, :800, :913, :934; docs.html.heex:65, :127, :706, :1352; design-system.md:244 (section 5 nav) and :321-322, :330 (section 7 hero); terms.html.heex:115; privacy.html.heex:137. docs.html.heex has a #delivery-loop section at :698 that keeps its summary and links the new page.

MDEx is a dependency (mix.exs:190). WikiShowLive renders with GFM extensions and default sanitize at lib/loopctl_web/live/wiki_show_live.ex:142-152. Reuse that option set through one shared function instead of copying it.

Design: /docs/delivery-loop follows docs/design-system.md sections 2 (Color Palette, dark only), 3 (Typography: Geist headings and body, Geist Mono for code), 4 (Layout Principles: the landing max-w-5xl content width) and 5 (Navigation (Landing Page) and Code Blocks). The sibling pages render with layout: false and their own nav (page_controller.ex:27-36), so the page reuses the docs page's nav markup and wraps the rendered HTML in WikiShowLive's prose class set (lib/loopctl_web/live/wiki_show_live.ex:92), shared through the same function as the MDEx options, so headings and code are styled rather than reset by Tailwind preflight. That set styles pre blocks prose-pre:bg-slate-950 prose-pre:border-slate-800, which section 5 Code Blocks does not draw (bg-slate-800, border-slate-700, text-slate-300, design-system.md:209-215), and two Tailwind classes for one property resolve by stylesheet order, not class order, so appending cannot override them: the shared function takes the pre classes as an argument, WikiShowLive passes its current ones, and this page passes prose-pre:bg-slate-800 prose-pre:border-slate-700 prose-pre:text-slate-300.

WellKnownController: repository_url at lib/loopctl_web/controllers/well_known_controller.ex:34 and contact at :62. Its schema action serves the JSON schema the discovery test checks (test/loopctl_web/controllers/well_known_controller_test.exs). WelcomeController already advertises the npm registry URL (welcome_controller.ex:66-67).

mcp-server/package.json:23-27 is the repository field; :35-40 is the files list, which already ships README.md. mcp-server-ci.yml's version-bump guard (:60-73) counts README.md as a shipped file, so this story bumps the package version.

Root README MCP section: README.md:786-914. The npx form already appears in mcp-server/README.md:9-17; the root README's .mcp.json uses a local path (`node /path/to/loopctl/mcp-server/index.js`, :800-801), which a reader without the source cannot use, so the package README keeps the npx form only.
non_goals: Changing what any API route authenticates: security must not depend on the source being hidden (PRD R12), and the routes are unchanged.
The visibility flip and the installers: US-52.66.
Publishing other repo docs on the site: only agent-delivery-loop.md, which a public page links to today, is served.

failure_modes.partition: n/a: every change is a static page, a compile-time file or a package file; no request reaches another service.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.65.3: the reference is compiled into the release from docs/agent-delivery-loop.md, so the served copy changes only with a deploy and can never come from a stale checkout.
failure_modes.retry: n/a: every route here is a GET with no side effect.
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.65.3: rendering happens at compile time, so a request does no markdown work and costs what /docs costs.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.65.7: the pages are served by every app machine through the unauthenticated pipelines, so they are reachable wherever loopctl.com answers.

definition_of_done: curl -s https://loopctl.com/docs/delivery-loop after deploy returns 200 and the reference's first heading.
curl -s https://loopctl.com/.well-known/loopctl | jq .mcp_server.package_url returns the npm URL.
npm view loopctl-mcp-server repository returns nothing for the bumped version.
defaults: Contact address on terms and privacy: operator@loopctl.com, the value /.well-known/loopctl already advertises (owner may change).
Repo links on the home and docs pages point to the npm package page (owner may change).
